milestone: Add multiple images/graphics to Manage Collection in one go
slice: Direct, mid-turn product request: 'also for collections in builder i would like to add multiple images in one go.' The Manage Collection screen's direct '+ Add Image'/'+ Add Graphic' controls drove a plain single-file <input type=file> via the shared _fileInputUpload(accept,onFile) helper -- selecting several files in the native OS picker in one go only ever registered the first, the rest silently discarded, since onFile fires exactly once by design. Fixed additively: a new _processUploadedFile(file,onFile) factors out the shared read/downscale/store pipeline (FileReader -> downscale-if-large -> _storeUploadedAsset) both the original single-file path and the new multi-file path now reuse; _fileInputUpload(accept,onFile) itself is completely unchanged in behavior/signature (still calls onFile exactly once), so every one of its ~9 other existing callers (Identity Thumbnail/Hero, Assets-screen slots, the Frame picker, the Experience content picker's own _assetUploadRow) is untouched. A new _fileInputUploadMulti(accept,onFile) builds a hidden <input type=file multiple> and calls onFile once per selected file -- each file's own upload/downscale/register pipeline runs independently, safe regardless of completion order since registerCollectionAsset's own synchronous mutation is already idempotent. Both Manage Collection buttons ('+ 🖼️ Add Image(s)', '+ 🎭 Add Graphic(s)') now build via _fileInputUploadMulti instead. Verified via a new 22-assertion Playwright suite: static checks confirm both buttons route through the new helper while the Experience content picker's own single-file path is unaffected; a real end-to-end UI drive selects 3 distinct real PNG fixtures on the real Add Image(s) input in ONE setInputFiles() call, confirming all 3 register as 3 distinct Collection entries with 3 distinct thumbnails (not just the first), then repeats for Add Graphic(s), reaching 6 correctly-kinded rows total. Full regression: both goldenBuild.js suites (30/30 each, unaffected) and the existing Collection Phase 1-5/direct-add/picker-layout Playwright suites all pass unchanged; a Creator-side layout test was independently confirmed via git stash to already fail identically on the unmodified baseline (a pre-existing, unrelated hardcoded-port quirk). No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js.
